verdict.rationale: Gunderson's own early-stage company page presents formation as part of its practice: it says the firm helps founders launch from the very start and structure their entities, ownership and IP. That establishes incorporation as a firm service, but the specific deliverables the story names are never documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of charter and bylaws drafting, initial board consents, founder stock purchase agreements, and independent or client corroboration of the formation service.

support.subject: As a founder, I can engage the firm to incorporate my company — charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase — documented as a core of its startup/emerging-companies practice

citations.quote: We have helped thousands of founders like you launch their businesses from the very start
we help founders make optimal, tax-efficient choices around how to structure their business entities and ownership, ensure that the company owns all of the intellectual property it will need
